description: User login result information, including whether the user is an admin or observer, session ID, and timestamp details.
guidance: This step should be used to verify the response of a user login operation, ensuring that all expected fields are present and correctly formatted.

output.name: is_admin
output.description: Indicates if the user has admin privileges.

output.name: is_observer
output.description: Indicates if the user is an observer.

output.name: session_id
output.description: The session ID allocated after successful login.

output.name: timestamp_delta
output.description: The difference in seconds between the server and local datetime.

output.name: timestamp_error
output.description: Indicates if there is a timestamp error, requiring the local system datetime to be updated.

output.name: user_id
output.description: The unique identifier for the logged-in user.

description: User login request with fields for name, observer, password, and signature.
guidance: To test this API, provide a valid user name, choose an observer mode if needed, and either a password or a signature for authentication.

input.name: name
input.description: name of the user; length: 1-32; charset: _, 0-9, a-z, A-Z

input.name: observer
input.description: the default is empty, 1 is forced login, 2 is observer mode login

input.name: password
input.description: login password; choose one of signature and password. for the security of your account, it is recommended to log in with signature.

input.name: signature
input.description: login signature; rules:SHA-1 encryption of:name+timestamp(int)+SHA-1 encrypted password

description: User login response, including code, message, and result.
guidance: Verify that the user login response contains a valid response code, an appropriate message, and the expected login result.

output.name: code
output.description: response code, zero for success, non-zero for errors

output.name: message
output.description: response message, description for the response code

guidance: This API is used for user login. Ensure the provided timestamp and body are correctly formatted.

input.name: timestamp
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Required body for user login request

output.description: OK response containing user login information
